Definition: Aven, the contemptuous synonym of three places, one in Coele-Syria, one in Egypt (On), and one in Palestine (Bethel)
BiblicalUsage: This is not the word for iniquity — it is a place-name, Aven, used with contempt. Amos names the plain of Aven among the places judged with Damascus, and Ezekiel names Aven, the Egyptian On, whose young men will fall by the sword.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God names the places of false worship one by one, and none of them stands when his judgment comes.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
